name: obsidian-vault
description: The taste vault's skills and hooks: /ingest turns a source and the user's words about it into pages and rules, and with batch takes in every new file in raw/refs/; /lint checks the whole wiki; /vault sets when agents propose rules; the hooks deliver the rules and pages to sessions. Set the vault option to a vault checkout.

vault.title: Vault folder
vault.description: The vault checkout whose .live/tools/ the hooks run, with .githooks/post-commit having made it.
